question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate idiom for the given underlined segment in the sentence.**

Riya always considers sincerity, devotion and dedication as the **__highest priority__**. of a good employee.
solution:
The correct answer is **"First and foremost."**

 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• 
 
The expression** "first and foremost"** is an idiom used to emphasize that something is the most important or highest priority. (इस बात पर ज़ोर देना कि कोई चीज़ सबसे महत्वपूर्ण या सर्वोच्च प्राथमिकता है)

 
 
• 
 
**Example:** *In planning the project, safety is **first and foremost**__.*

 
 
 
 
• 
 
It is often used to highlight a primary consideration or point in a list or sequence.

 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is** Option 4.**

 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

 
• **Fair and square: **justly, honestly, and straightforwardly. (न्यायपूर्वक, ईमानदारी से, और सीधे तौर पर)
 
• **Ever and anon: **now and then or occasionally. (कभी-कभार)
 
• **Free and easy: **a relaxed and informal atmosphere or demeanor. (एक आरामदायक और अनौपचारिक माहौल या आचरण)
